⬢ TANK BAZAAR — Companies and data bundles (V435a: 15 slugs aligned to TWI)

Run this after the terminal seeder (seed-terminals-…-V435.html). It does three things:

  1. Writes the register companies to companies/CO#####, each with its Tankonomics slug ( keep their existing Tankonomics slug, old duplicate slugs kept as redirects).
  2. Reads the live terminals collection once and packs it into a few bundles/terminals-N documents, plus bundles/companies-N (the company index).
  3. Writes bundles/manifest last. tankbazaar.com then reads about 1 to 8 documents per visit instead of all terminals.

Needs the new firestore.rules (bundles, companies, bundleEdits) published first. After any later terminal seeder run, open the latest version of this page and press Rebuild bundles only.
